beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So the work done for those who've passed is built on one promise: that death is not the last word.

beats.text: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

beats.text: That is Paul's foundation — not a metaphor or a wish.

beats.text: And because He rose, the grave loses its grip — for Him first, and then for all who belong to Him.

beats.text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
